title: cli/serve --dev: an OS_DATABASE_URL whose scheme the CLI does not recognise is ignored in silence, and the boot serves an in-memory SQLite store instead of the database the operator named
body:
Filing gate **①**, class **(a)**. `reach:` **measured at the public door** `OS_DATABASE_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6399/0 objectstack serve objectstack.config.ts --dev`, on a host fixture with an auth secret, at `650e28a731`.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01Q9PZ5Pzqcus4woVvTZwWNU`, from #23573's build report (`os-dev-report` on #23573, PR #23631, head `650e28a731`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## What was measured

- The boot printed `✓ Server is ready` with the banner `Driver: SqlDriver(better-sqlite3) → :memory:`.
- No line said the URL was ignored, so the operator's named database was silently replaced by an in-memory store.

## Why, read on the source

- `inferDriverTypeFromUrl` (`packages/cli/src/utils/storage-driver.ts`) answers `''` for an unrecognised scheme, and `resolveStorageDefinition` falls through to the dev `:memory:` default.
- An unrecognised `OS_DATABASE_DRIVER` is already refused there ("Booting on the SQLite default instead would silently ignore the driver you asked for"); the URL arm has no such refusal.
- In production the same URL now reaches PR #23631's no-storage refusal, so the silent half is `--dev` only.

## Reader who acts

Triage grades it and routes it. The landing is `packages/cli/src/utils/storage-driver.ts` (`domain:cli`): refuse an unrecognised `OS_DATABASE_URL` scheme as the driver arm does.

**Dedupe words:** unrecognized OS_DATABASE_URL scheme ignored; serve --dev unknown database URL falls back to memory; inferDriverTypeFromUrl empty string silent SQLite default.
